textContent.text: It is time for the fox party.
"Let's make our tails look pretty," says Lucy Fox. She puts red flowers in her tail.
"But I don't have anything pretty," says Sammy Fox.

All the bees sit on Sammy's tail. His tail looks pretty! And it makes a soft sound.
"Your tail looks great!" says Lucy Fox.
Now the foxes are ready for the party!

contents.text: Stories are made up of many different parts. Some important parts are the problem, solution, and plot.
The problem is something that goes wrong for the characters, or something that needs to be fixed.
The solution is how the characters deal with the problem. Sometimes they can fix the problem. Other times, they may deal with the problem in a different way.
The plot is what happens in a story. It tells us what happens, or the events, from the beginning to the end. You can put the events in order using words like first, next, and last.
Identifying the problem, solution, and plot helps you better understand the story.
